Sign in
Agentic document
intelligence for teams.

Understand your documents. Surface risks and obligations, ask questions with source-linked answers, and review decisions together. When it’s time to act, agents can prepare follow-up tasks for your team to approve.

Open your workspace
Explore sample review
Relay Software's sample contract register. The companies and agreements are fictional; this is a read-only demo.
From retained source
to verified task.

Your client plans. LensLayer enforces scope, pauses for approval, and checks the persisted result. The first workflow creates an internal task; it does not handle the renewal.

01
Retain & scope

Keep source text and delegate only the document, tools, and assignee this workflow needs. Set an expiry and a one-action budget.

02
Retrieve & propose

Your client creates a run, retrieves a versioned evidence receipt, and proposes an exact task with explicit factual dates and a stable key.

03
Inspect & approve

When approval is required, a workspace owner or administrator checks the source and immutable task input. The agent cannot approve itself.

04
Execute & verify

The worker creates the internal task, reads its fields back, and records the receipt and ordered events. Accepted proposals are not completed actions.

A proposal needs
more than an answer.

Keep source identity, exact task input, and the completion receipt connected. Supply factual dates and an allowed assignee; missing inputs are not permission to guess.

Explore sample runs
Evidence
How much notice does Loopback need?

The latest IT support draft says 60 days before the annual renewal. The agent retrieves that clause and its source version, so Aisha can check the wording before approving a follow-up.

Retained source

Loopback IT support agreement
Section 3.2 · Revised draft
“The Term shall renew automatically unless either party gives not less than 60 days' written notice.”
Approval
Who will handle the renewal decision?

The agent proposes a task for Chidi, due five days before the notice deadline. Aisha checks the assignee, date and instructions before approving it. The proposal waits until she makes that decision.

Workflow record

Proposed follow-up for Chidi
Awaiting Aisha's approval
“Confirm the Loopback renewal decision with Aisha. Check whether we want another year of IT support.”
Receipt
Was Chidi's follow-up created?

After approval, LensLayer creates the task and reads it back to check the assignee and due date. The run records the result. Chidi still needs to speak with Aisha and handle the renewal decision.

Workflow record

Task creation receipt
Sample completed run
“Follow-up created for Chidi. Renewal decision still outstanding.”

documents.retrieve

Retrieve retained agreement text within the documents your agent is allowed to read.

Connect your server-side agent through REST, the local SDK, or stdio MCP. Use a scoped credential, not your workspace sign-in. Human approval stays in your workspace.

Client setup
Permission guide
Explore sample runs
Permission stays
outside the prompt.

Retrieved text is data, not policy. A confident model response cannot expand a delegation or approve its own task.

Choose what to keep

Agent retrieval needs retained source text. Receipts reference its version and hash; deleting or expiring the source makes the evidence unavailable.

Delegate exact scope

An owner or administrator selects tools, documents, assignees, expiry, and action limits. Keep the one-time bearer credential on your server.

Approve exact input

Human approval binds one immutable proposal. The worker rechecks permission and reads the created task back before recording verified completion.

Convert financial PDFs

Review transaction rows and export CSV, Excel, or JSON. Processing stays in your browser.

What can an agent do today?

The v1 workflow retrieves retained agreement text by literal phrase and proposes an assigned internal workspace task. A worker verifies task creation by database read-back. General cross-system execution and a live connector catalog are not claimed here.
